quality.notes: rewrite_compose_statements collects resolve_alias_statement results and calls expect, while resolve_alias_binder can propagate the CoreError produced by resolve_alias_qualified_name for an unknown namespace. Because lower_compose calls this infallibly for common-init statements, the stated typed-binder input can panic instead of returning Err.

rewrite_lvalue actually does receive the bound set, using it for index expressions, while deliberately resolving an assignment's base through rewrite_state_name; rewrite_expr separately preserves bound-variable reads. This supports the intended distinction that LValue bases denote writable state, not writable ForAll binders, so the described “local write” is unsupported.
